CustomField.description: Value for the Key Date portion of the Account Plan Score
CustomField.formula:
IF(Default_Plan_Scoring__c, (IF( $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Key_Dates.Score_Object__c, CASE(1, IF(Key_Dates_Count__c < $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Key_Dates.Count_BP_Low__c, 1, 0), 0, IF(Key_Dates_Count__c < $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Key_Dates.Count_BP_Mid__c, 1, 0), $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Key_Dates.Score_BP_Low__c, IF(Key_Dates_Count__c < $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Key_Dates.Count_BP_High__c, 1, 0), $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Key_Dates.Score_BP_Mid__c, $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Key_Dates.Score_BP_High__c) * IF( $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Key_Dates.Use_Time_Decay__c, CASE(1, IF(TODAY() - DATEVALUE(KD_Max_LMD__c) < $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Key_Dates.Time_BP_Low__c, 1, 0), 1, IF(TODAY() - DATEVALUE(KD_Max_LMD__c) < $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Key_Dates.Time_BP_Mid__c, 1, 0), $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Key_Dates.Time_BP_Mult_Low__c, IF(TODAY() - DATEVALUE(KD_Max_LMD__c) < $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Key_Dates.Time_BP_High__c, 1, 0), $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Key_Dates.Time_BP_Mult_Mid__c, $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Key_Dates.Time_BP_Mult_High__c), 1), 0)),
(IF( Key_Dates_Count__c > $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Key_Dates.Threshold_Limit__c , $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Key_Dates.Category_Point_Total__c, (Key_Dates_Count__c / $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Key_Dates.Threshold_Limit__c)* $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Key_Dates.Category_Point_Total__c)) * IF( $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Key_Dates.Use_Time_Decay__c, CASE(1, IF(TODAY() - DATEVALUE(KD_Max_LMD__c) < $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Key_Dates.Time_BP_Low__c, 1, 0), 1, IF(TODAY() - DATEVALUE(KD_Max_LMD__c) < $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Key_Dates.Time_BP_Mid__c, 1, 0), $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Key_Dates.Time_BP_Mult_Low__c, IF(TODAY() - DATEVALUE(KD_Max_LMD__c) < $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Key_Dates.Time_BP_High__c, 1, 0), $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Key_Dates.Time_BP_Mult_Mid__c, $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Key_Dates.Time_BP_Mult_High__c), 1))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: You can modify this by adjusting the custom metadata record corresponding to the Key Date Values
CustomField.label: Key Date Score
